Class RainbowMaterial

java.lang.Object
net.murat.material.RainbowMaterial
All Implemented Interfaces:
Material
public class RainbowMaterial extends Object implements Material
RainbowMaterial - creates a true rainbow effect where colors smoothly transition across the surface based on surface position or angle, similar to a CD/DVD reflection or actual rainbow.

The rainbow follows the visible spectrum order: Red -> Orange -> Yellow -> Green -> Blue -> Indigo -> Violet

      Description copied from interface: Material
      Calculates the final color at a given point on the surface, considering the material's properties and the light source.
      Specified by:
      getColorAt in interface Material
      Parameters:
      point - The point in 3D space (world coordinates) where the light hits.
      normal - The normal vector at the point (world coordinates).
      light - The single light source affecting this point.
      viewerPoint - The position of the viewer/camera.
      Returns:
      The packed ARGB integer color value (0xaarrggbb) contributed by this specific light.
